summary: Frontend-only test of new 'Live compliance' panel in CRM Aftersales Contracts > Contracts & Renewals sub-tab. Logged in as owner@isodemo.com, Corporate mode, opened Aftersales Contracts tab and clicked afs-tab-contracts. Verified all 7 acceptance criteria pass.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded AFSCOMPLDEMO-contract-1 (AlphaCo Site A) plus existing Example Fire & Rescue Service contract.

AlphaCo card shows Service:overdue next 2026-11-10, Billing:overdue next 2026-10-06 £350, Sicon:Pending, Sage:Synced. Fire & Rescue card shows neutral 'No service schedule'/'No billing schedule' and Sicon/Sage 'Not synced'. Expand lazy-loads detail with 3 visits (Completed/Overdue/Planned) and 6 invoices (2 Paid, 1 Overdue, 3 Scheduled). Refresh button works. contracts-list still present below panel. Two harmless 404 console errors observed (likely unrelated static resource).
